comparison.objective: Clamp wooden stock in a screw vise and saw off a 150 mm piece; candidate performs screen separation and recovery.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1984 requires vise clamping, bimanual saw guidance, repeated cutting contact, and dimensional cut control. Candidate requires balanced two-tab lifting, orientation-sensitive agitation, particle passage/retention, and precise screen replacement.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1984 awards partial credit for secure clamping and a full-width groove at least 10 mm deep; full credit needs two physical pieces, retained length 150±1 mm, saw clearance, and limited unintended damage. Candidate instead uses recovered mass, total washer retention, valid aperture transit, no spill/breakage, support/release, and 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: Material removal to a dimensional endpoint and selective many-body screening test unrelated physical abilities despite both involving force control.
